data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'manam', meaning 'to be gentle, tender, and compassionate'. The name Mahnam represents a person who is graceful, delicate, and beautiful in their actions and demeanor. The name Mahnam carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahnam usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
